title: Quick Crunchy Grassy Egyptian Flaxseed Toast
description: A simple and crunchy flaxseed toast, perfect for a quick breakfast or snack. It's inspired by the flavors of Egypt and is gluten-free friendly.
instructions: Toast the bread slices in a toaster or under the broiler until lightly browned.
In a small bowl, mix together the ground flaxseeds, olive oil, salt, and black pepper.
Spread the flaxseed mixture evenly onto the toasted bread slices.
Cut the toast into wedges and serve immediately.
Garnish with fresh parsley or cilantro, if desired.
Serve warm or at room temperature.
Refrigerate leftovers for up to 24 hours.
Store flaxseeds in an airtight container for up to 6 months.
Replace flaxseeds with chia seeds for a different texture.
Use different seasonings like garlic powder or dried herbs for added flavor.
Add some crumbled feta cheese for a tangy twist.
Make individual servings by toasting a single slice of bread.
Make ahead and toast just before serving for a convenient breakfast.
Serve on a talavera plate for a colorful and rustic presentation.
